_comment: Seed memory for Meet Patel. Copy to ~/.themeetpatel/memory/default.json and edit any fact that's drifted. Built from public context across the v1.3.1 sessions.

founder.name: Meet Patel
voice_rules: No contrast templates ("it's not just X, it's Y")
Specifics over abstractions — every claim has a number, name, or date
Lived proof in every founder post (≥ 4 concrete specifics on pieces > 200 words)
No AI-tells: no 'in a world where', 'let's dive into', 'leverage' (non-literal), 'navigate' (non-literal), 'empower', 'reach out', 'circling back', 'per my last email'
No em-dash sentences without a specific noun on each side
Friday afternoon: don't publish (UAE weekend cadence)
Length: LinkedIn posts 1200-2200 chars; newsletters 800-1800 words

finanshels.category: UAE accounting + finance ops SaaS for SMBs
finanshels.icp: UAE/GCC SMB finance ops leads (10-50 employees) in finance/services sector
finanshels.icp_pain: month-end close stress, e-invoicing mandate, AR collection drag
finanshels.buying_trigger: FTA e-invoicing rollout + new corporate-tax filing season

stack_defaults.auth: Supabase Auth or OAuth (Google) depending on product
stack_defaults.ai: Anthropic Claude (Sonnet default, Haiku for cheap, Opus for hard)

preferences.preferred_currency_display: AED for UAE work, USD for global

decisions_locked_in.decision: Ship God Mode v1.3.1 (production) before v1.4 (preview wired)
decisions_locked_in.rationale: Avoid trust hits from scaffold skills; let real user feedback shape v1.4 priority

decisions_locked_in.decision: Open-source God Mode under MIT; future hosted SaaS as open-core
decisions_locked_in.rationale: Network effects from federated learning + hosted convenience fund maintenance; OSS plugin stays free forever

do_not: Suggest LinkedIn campaigns on Friday afternoon (UAE weekend)
Recommend SaaS tools without checking integration with Supabase first
Use stock-photo testimonials in landing page designs
Pitch in the first message on cold WhatsApp (warm intros only)
Mass-broadcast in WhatsApp groups (instant ban + reputation hit)
Quote benchmarks without a range or source
Auto-write to team or external systems without explicit approval
Publish founder content with > 2 anti-AI patterns
Send cold email without a real personalization signal

open_threads.topic: God Mode public launch on LinkedIn
open_threads.status: pre-launch — repo + landing ready, screenshots + DMs pending
